text: Equally important, the length of most periodization studies is relatively short, generally lasting a maximum of 12 weeks. Given that overtraining tends to manifest over longer periods, the majority of studies simply aren't properly designed to investigate the impact of periodization on hypertrophic outcomes. In the longest periodization study to date, Kraemer and colleagues (73) reported that female tennis players gained a significantly greater amount of fat-free mass following a periodized compared to a nonperiodized resistance training program over 9 months (3.3 vs. 1.6 kg, or 7.2 vs. 3.5 lb, respectively). Results must be viewed with circumspection, however, as the skinfold method was employed to estimate fat-free mass.

chapter: Chapter 8: Program Design for Maximal Hypertrophy
